_comment: Tier-2 SYNTHETIC (linear_elasticity::90, the sentinel range the coverage metric excludes): dolfinx.fem.functionspace rejects an element family basix does not register. RE-KEYED 2026-08-06 off linear_elasticity::8, an index past the end of that pitfall list — the list stops at 7, so the key named nothing. The claim it actually defends is linear_elasticity::6, and that is already owned by p1_family_name_rejected_cg_deprecated, which additionally pins that 'CG' still works with a deprecation warning. Crediting no claim is better than miscrediting one, so this moves to the sentinel range rather than onto a live slot. MUTATION CONTROL (T2_MUTATE=1, re-runnable): asking for 'Lagrange' instead of 'NotAFamily' builds the space and prints 'family_accepted=True space_dim=25', so the expectations 'ValueError' and 'Unknown element family' both go missing. Proved KILLED 2026-08-07.
_key_correction: RE-KEYED to the >=90 sentinel range, which the coverage metric excludes. History: it was keyed linear_elasticity::8, an index past the end of a 7-entry list, so it credited nothing. During consolidation it was briefly moved to ::6 because claim #6 IS the element-family claim — that was verified but incomplete: knowledge/fenics-verify had already written p1_family_name_rejected_cg_deprecated as the dedicated fixture for #6, and two fixtures on one key make the runner mark BOTH failed. A claim may have only one owner. This one keeps the sentinel, credits no claim, and the collision was caught by the post-merge fixture-key measurement.

_mutation.note: Antidote: spell a family basix does register ('Lagrange'). The space is built, nothing raises, and the probe prints its dimension.
